newsitem.title: USA: Capitol, American Travellers up on deals. [CORRECTED 15:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Capitol, American Travellers up on deals. [CORRECTED 15:40 GMT]

text.p: Capitol American Financial Corp's share price rose more than 40 percent (corrects size of rise) in early trading on news it had agreed to be acquired by Conseco Inc for about $650 million in cash and Conseco stock.
Conseco also agreed to buy American Travellers Corp for about $793 million in Conseco stock.
American Travellers rose 3-1/8, or about 11 percent, to 31-1/2.
Conseco shares also moved higher on the news, gaining 1-15/16 to 43-7/8.
Conseco was scheduled to hold a conference call with analysts and the media Monday morning.

Conseco said it also planned to acquire the shares it does not already own of American Life Holdings for about $165 million in cash, and the rest of Bankers Life Holding Corp for about $117 million in Conseco stock.
The deals are the latest for acquisitive Conseco, which agreed to buy Life Partners Group Inc in March for $600 million in stock and $240 million of Life Partners' debt.
Conseco has been one of the most active insurance buyers over the last decade or so, buying over a dozen companies since 1982.
